new_claims.claim: Existing reviews organize observation problem variants, operations, agents and maneuver design; this review uses cross-layer decision dependencies as a complementary analytical scope.
new_claims.kind: source-supported scope comparison plus author framing

new_claims.claim: The three-level state/decision/constraint/feedback table is an author analytical organization, not a claim that all cited studies implement a single architecture.

The single-agent constellation paper implements no communication, single-degree LOS, multi-degree LOS and free communication; it shares completed imaging/downlink states rather than action intentions.

Incremental continuous planning was faster but more redundant than from-scratch continuous planning in the stated broadcast allocation experiments; times were from a single-threaded distributed simulation.
On large JAIR instances, NSS-GND reduces run time and message volume relative to BD while retaining a request-satisfaction trade-off; simulation runtime uses the slowest agent.
